corruption.","question_ids":["7B.9","7B.10","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023 as a formal governance directive.","ruler_attribution":"The directives were issued opposition to biological weapons, humanitarian assistance, and postwar reconstruction.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.5","1B.8","2B.1","2B.3","2B.4","2B.7","2B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The document is an
